title: Declarative login steps for one application
description: One reviewed sign-in description per application, stored at src/data/loginSteps/<family>/<id>.json (t102 contract L1). It decides where a saved credential may be typed, so every object is closed: an unknown kind or field rejects the file. This schema covers structure and bounds only. The validator in src/utils/connection/httpLoginSteps.ts is authoritative and additionally requires: id equal to the file name; a real calendar date; every step and challenge origin listed in credentialOrigins, and every listed origin used; at least one credential step; a password step only after an identifier or form step unless passwordOnly; each credential typed at most once per origin; a click only before a credential step on its origin; a submit directly after the step it submits; at most one submit per origin and credential stage; unique challenge ids. Where this schema is intentionally weaker than the validator: (1) every length bound on free text (a selector, waitFor, a challenge's codeSelector and submitSelector, evidence.source and a challenge label) is counted in UTF-16 units by the validator, as the engines count, while maxLength here counts characters, so text containing characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane can satisfy this schema and still be refused; (2) the validator also requires an origin to survive URL parsing unchanged, so a host with malformed punycode such as xn--a.com satisfies the pattern here and is refused. In both cases the validator is stricter and is the authority.

id.description: Application profile id; equal to the file's base name.

credentialOrigins.description: Every origin other than the connection's own on which a step may run. Required even when empty: [] states that credentials go only to the connection's own origin.

passwordOnly.description: A device with no username. Only click, password and submit steps are allowed. Defaults to false.

selector.description: A CSS selector: no control characters, no leading or trailing space.

origin.description: An exact HTTPS origin of a public DNS name: lower case, no path, no trailing slash, no default port, no IP literal, no single-label host, and no name whose last label is a special-use or private-use suffix (localhost, local, test, invalid, example, onion, alt, internal, arpa, localdomain, lan, home, corp, mail, intranet, private). Such a host can only be the connection's own origin, which a step reaches by omitting origin.

path.description: An exact pathname, compared case-sensitively with location.pathname.

pathPrefix.description: A directory ending in a slash; matches that path and everything below it. The root is not a prefix: omit the gate instead.

frame.description: id or name of a direct child iframe of the top document, same origin as the top document.

class.description: A: from an authoritative cited source. B: unverified, an informed guess nobody has confirmed against the live page.

source.description: The primary citation of tests/fixtures/logins/<id>/evidence.json, repeated exactly: a URL, a repository path or a capture name, without spaces.

reviewed.description: The review date of that evidence.json, repeated exactly.

clickStep.description: A pre-step: clicks one control before a credential step on the same origin.

formStep.description: Types the username and the password into one form.

submitControlStep.description: Submits the credential step directly before it by clicking a reviewed control, in that step's document. click: an ordinary POST form. spa: a single-page form with no POST action.

submitEnterStep.description: Submits the credential step directly before it by pressing Enter in the field that step typed. It names no control.

totpChallenge.description: A reviewed authenticator-code challenge in the catalog's existing shape. paths are exact.
